title: RIKEN CBS Summer Program 2027
institution: RIKEN Center for Brain Science (RIKEN CBS)
level: Undergraduate, graduate or early-career (beyond high school)
about: RIKEN Center for Brain Science offers a two-month research internship (Plan A, June 8 - August 5, 2027) and a one-week lecture course (Plan B, July 5-9, 2027) at its Wako campus. Applications are open until January 8, 2027, 9:00 a.m. JST.
requirements: Enrolled at an academic institution or company at application and throughout the program; high school students ineligible
CV, motivation letter (about 500 words) and one recommendation letter; Plan A also needs an internship project description
Full on-site attendance at RIKEN Wako Campus, Saitama
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the RIKEN CBS Summer Program 2027 at RIKEN Center for Brain Science (RIKEN CBS), Wako, Japan; deadline 8 Jan 2027. The photo is Japan's country image, Tokyo Tower and the Tokyo skyline at sunset, not Wako.
